dogecoin.text: All this Dogecoin hype is the worst thing to ever happen to #BTC .  BTC was seen as the leader and most legitimate crypto, but we are seeing how easily cryptos can be replaced and since they have no intrinsic value (other than tax evasion/money laundering, etc), they can go to 0.

@TeslaAndBitcoin Yeah, I mean, even $10k might be a stretch for some.  The other FOMO part is - how do you catch every future #Dogecoin?  There are dozens of #shitcoins popping up all the time; any of which could be suddenly endorsed by someone like #ElonMusk or @CathieDWood rocket to the moon.🚀

Strong Risk On day in full swing.  $TSLA $ARKK and Big Tech up sharply as Treasuries rise (yields📉) signalling reduced inflation expectations.  And right now the biggest 'Risk On' asset seems to be #Crypto .  #cryptocurrency to the moon!  
$BTC #Bitcoin #dogecoin $SPX #DowJones

$MSTR and @michael_saylor lost $630M on their $BTC today - a couple of days after taking out a ~$500M loan to buy bitcoin.  
$TSLA is now in the red on the bitcoin they have left; which will have to be included as a loss in their next quarterly statement.  And $DOGE..
Wild stuff.
